_comment: Brand values applied to the copy of the upstream client by rebrand/rebrand.py. No server is built in: DefaultControlURL is a reserved .invalid name (RFC 6761) that never resolves, so a client that was not given your server's address (join.sh --login-server, join.ps1 -LoginServer, or 'Use an alternate server' in the Android app) cannot connect anywhere. Log upload and the update check are compiled out (LogHost and UpdateBaseURL stay empty).
